gaps: Founding year / company history / "About" copy: not stated anywhere official (/about is 404). Do not invent a founded date or origin story.
Owner/leadership: the site names no owner, executives or staff titles (WP has users "Joey Namou"/"Joseph Namou" with 0 posts). Do not present anyone as founder/CEO.

Contact: no phone, street address or contact form on the site (/contact 404). Only email found is [admin email removed — ask client] as podcast-feed owner (Big D Energy feed) — confirm before publishing.

Advertising/sponsorship: /advertise is 404; no rate card, media kit, audience numbers or sponsor list exist on the site. Any "Advertise with us" section must be a generic CTA without invented stats or partner logos.

Audience stats: only YouTube figures are verifiable (111K subscribers, 22,150 videos, 163,827,195 views as of 2026-10-08). No follower counts for Facebook/X/Instagram/TikTok, no download numbers, no listener/visitor stats.
Spotify for Crunch Time (WSN feed "Crunch Time Sports", Spreaker 7042776): not found — spotify is null; use Apple Podcasts/Spreaker.
Android app: no live Google Play listing (the link in YouTube descriptions 404s). Show iOS only.
Weekend programming: none listed (one YouTube description says "7 Days a Week" but all schedules are Mon–Fri). Treat weekends as off-air/replays.
Exact hours between shows (10–11 AM, 1–2 PM, 4–5 PM) are not described — do not fill them with invented programming.
Host bios/headshots: only the one-paragraph show descriptions exist; no individual host bios, photos or social handles are published (show art images contain the hosts).
Show pages' "Watch Live / Apple Podcasts / Spotify" buttons are dead "#" links on the current site — the URLs in shows[] were sourced from Apple/Spreaker/Spotify directly.
Homepage "APP STORE" and "YOUTUBE LIVE" buttons are unlinked spans on the current site; use app.ios_url and youtube_channel.live_url.

Red Wings coverage is thin (3 posts) and Michigan State has 3 (+1 MSU); NCAA/Big Ten coverage is small — avoid implying deep beat coverage there.
